prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1249; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented four times following a motor vehicle collision in which another vehicle sideswiped their car while changing lanes. At the initial visit the patient reported immediate pain and swelling in the right knee, with limited weight-bearing and tenderness along the medial joint line. Examination showed moderate effusion, positive medial stress testing with mild laxity, and intact neurovascular status distally. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture, and none was identified.

Over the second and third visits, treatment consisted of rest, ice, compression, a hinged knee brace for ambulation, and a structured physical therapy program focusing on quadriceps activation and range of motion. Swelling decreased steadily, and the patient progressed from crutches to independent walking by the third visit.

At the fourth and final visit, the patient had regained near-full range of motion with minimal residual effusion and reported pain at a low level with daily activities. Diagnosis was a medial collateral ligament sprain of the right knee, grade two. The patient was advised to continue a home exercise program, avoid high-impact activity for several weeks, and return if symptoms worsen or fail to improve.
